title: Filament spool holder
prompt: Filament spool holder that sits on a shelf: a 60 x 60 x 5 mm base plate with four M4 clearance holes (4.5 mm) on a 50 mm square pattern, and a 30 mm diameter, 80 mm tall round spindle standing in the middle of the plate, with a 2 mm chamfer on its top edge. Centre it on the origin, Z up, base on Z = 0.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Two bodies: the base plate and the spindle
60 x 60 mm footprint, 85 mm tall overall
Centred on the origin, sitting on Z = 0
Four M4 clearance holes (4.3–4.6 mm) on a 50 mm square
A 30 mm x 80 mm spindle with a chamfered (conical) top edge
A 60 x 60 x 5 mm base plate
